procedure: Record the final topic-specific terms, filters, search date, result count, and exported NCT identifiers from the official search interface.
limitations: Registry records may be incomplete or updated after the search date.

procedure: Use the official ICTRP portal or authorised export pathway and record exact terms, date, filters, result count, and identifiers.
limitations: Portal coverage and export availability vary; no automated scraping is permitted.

procedure: Search the official ANZCTR interface and record exact terms, filters, dates, result count, and ACTRN identifiers.
limitations: Interface behaviour and indexing may change after the recorded search.

procedure: Search the official OSF interface with recorded terms and filters; export only metadata permitted by the source.
limitations: Private projects and unindexed files are outside observable coverage.

procedure: Record exact Zenodo query text, communities or type filters, search date, result count, and persistent identifiers.
limitations: Repository metadata quality and version linkage vary by depositor.

procedure: Record exact Figshare query text, item filters, search date, result count, and persistent identifiers.
limitations: Institutional instances may not be completely represented in central search.

procedure: Name each Dataverse installation searched and record exact terms, filters, date, result count, and persistent identifiers.
limitations: Dataverse is federated; searching one installation is not exhaustive.

procedure: Declare each institution and repository interface, then record exact query or browse path, date, and inspected range.
limitations: Coverage is limited to the explicitly named repositories and their exposed indexes.

procedure: Declare conference names, years, abstract books or proceedings, exact query or browse range, and inspected pages.
limitations: Unpublished, withdrawn, or inaccessible abstracts may be missed.

procedure: Declare each thesis index or repository and record exact terms, filters, date, result count, and identifiers.
limitations: Embargoed and non-digitised theses remain outside observable coverage.

procedure: Declare jurisdictions and policy portals, then record exact terms, filters, date, and inspected result range.
limitations: Policy pages may be replaced without durable version history.

procedure: Name each organisation and record site-search or search-engine syntax, domains, date, and inspected result range.
limitations: Search-engine and site indexes are dynamic and cannot establish exhaustive coverage.

procedure: Resolve a declared seed identifier through a bounded fixture-backed citation response; live use requires explicit provider authority and a receipt.
limitations: Citation graphs are incomplete, versioned, and not evidence of exhaustive forward chaining.

procedure: Record each seed report identifier, the exact bibliography or reference-list range inspected, the inspection date, total references and candidate identifiers; do not infer that unavailable or truncated references were searched.
limitations: Reference lists may be incomplete, truncated or unavailable.
Manual checking is bounded to the declared seed reports and ranges.

procedure: Record the approved contact template, recipient role rather than personal identity, date, response status, and candidate identifiers.
limitations: Non-response and selective response can create unknown coverage risk.

procedure: Record the exact journal, proceedings series, website section, date or volume range, pages inspected, and candidate identifiers.
limitations: Coverage is bounded to the explicitly logged range.
